charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10002
EEOC Office: Phoenix District Office
Charging Party: Avery Foster
City/State: Denver, CO
Respondent: Cedar Plumbing Inc.
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Age, National Origin
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 11/03/2025 Latest 05/07/2026
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Cedar Plumbing Inc beginning before November 03, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about November 03, 2025 and continued through May 07, 2026.
2. I was issued written discipline for conduct that similarly situated employees engaged in
without consequence.
3. I requested a reasonable accommodation and my request was denied without discussion.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my age and national origin, in
violation of applicable federal law.
notice:
U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION
Phoenix District Office
NOTICE OF CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Date of Notice: 08/03/2026
To: Cedar Plumbing Inc.
Re: Charge No. 410-2026-10002
This is notice that a charge of employment discrimination has been filed against your
organization. No action is required on your part at this time. A position statement may be
requested.
